description: Confirm the sandbox baseline in the scratch repo before any change: the scratch repo is on branch codex/release-rework-20261024 at a6cc9fcd with a clean status, and record pass/fail counts of the directly affected test files using the sandbox runner. Planner already observed: main-prebuild-queue-v2 10/11 (the 'crash before dispatch' test spawns a child node without the pipe shim, sandbox-limited), main-prebuild-generation-rejection 6/6, release-scope-plan TIMEOUT (spawns git), preparation-resolution TIMEOUT (spawns children).
steps: In PowerShell: $env:GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL='NUL'; & D:\git\Git\cmd\git.exe -c safe.directory=* -C D:\运营管理系统\.codex-tmp\rework-20261024\repo status --short --branch ; and log --oneline -1. Expect branch codex/release-rework-20261024, HEAD a6cc9fcd, clean.

Run: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File D:\运营管理系统\.codex-tmp\rework-20261024\run-test.ps1 main-prebuild-queue-v2 main-prebuild-generation-rejection publish-latest-main publish-main-step publish-main-completed main-prebuild-status -TimeoutSec 120 (separately, one call per 2-3 files so a hang does not eat the tool timeout).
For each failing/timeout test, look at %TEMP%\rework-tests\<name>.out and classify the cause as sandbox-limited (child_process spawn, git, powershell) or real. Do not fix anything in this feature.
Write the baseline table (file, tests, pass, fail, cause) into this feature's findings field.
acceptance_criteria: findings lists baseline counts for every file run and the cause of each failure/timeout
No file in the scratch repo is modified (git status clean)
